nodes.summary:
Experimental local JSON protocol companion; reads one request on stdin and writes its response on stdout.
--candidate: verified release candidate directory
--evidence-file: TSV of ROW, STATUS, PATH, DECISION and REASON, one supplied row per line
--output: new file for the record; an existing file is refused (build mode)
--source-root: Corvint Git checkout containing the candidate commit (build mode)
--store-candidate-sha256: task-store candidate SHA-256 (build mode, optional)
--store-release: task-store release id (build mode, optional)
--verify: readiness record to verify; selects verify mode, which writes nothing
usage: corvint-readiness-record [--candidate VALUE] [--evidence-file VALUE] [--output VALUE] [--source-root VALUE] [--store-candidate-sha256 VALUE] [--store-release VALUE] [--verify VALUE]
